translations.web: For these two years the famine has been in the land, and there are yet five years, in which there will be no plowing and no harvest.
translations.bsb: For the famine has covered the land these two years, and there will be five more years without plowing or harvesting.
translations.kjv: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.
translations.asv: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and there are yet five years, in which there shall be neither plowing nor harvest.
